neighbours.label: ' our' or ' your' after a verb of keeping or looking after (retaining our employees, care for your staff, keeping our young people), as opposed to ' my' and ' his' and to these pronouns as sentence subjects
fire: We must focus on keeping our best teachers.
This guide helps you look after your team.
The fund goes toward protecting our young children.
Companies should work on retaining your top talent.
She talked about feeding our growing cities.
Good benefits help you care for your workers.
We need to stop losing our skilled nurses.
The plan is about supporting our local farmers.
quiet: We sold my best suit on Monday.
This guide was given to me by his brother.
Our school opens at nine each day.
Your bus leaves from the north gate.
He looked at his watch and left.
My coat is on the chair in the hall.
Our cat sleeps on my bed most nights.
Your letter arrived on Tuesday morning.

short: our/your after keep or care for
notes: Probes fired with objects too ('washing our old cars' 0.34, 'care for your shoes' 0.40), so the people in the fire items may not matter. Those are not near misses here; the test leaves that open.
